ModMetaData.name: RimLTC - Rim Long-Term Care
ModMetaData.author: DreamOver9183
ModMetaData.description:
A lightweight, vanilla-friendly old-age, hospice care and legacy mod.
Elderly pawns eventually develop Natural Senescence: a single three-stage condition (frail, bedridden, terminal) that ends in a natural death. Caring for them uses only vanilla jobs (feeding, cleaning, tending) and a separate hospice care policy (no care / hands only / herbal / industrial) that never wastes glitterworld medicine.
Good long-term care is rewarded: elders may leave a skilltrainer of their best skill by their bedside, and a hidden care satisfaction score decides how the colony feels about their passing (neglected, regretful, peaceful or transcendent).
Bionic organs, the biosculpter pod and Biotech ageless genes are all taken into account.
極致輕量、貼合原版的老年衰亡、安寧長照與技藝傳承模組。高齡殖民者會進入「生理衰竭」三階段（初期虛弱、臥床失能、臨終彌留）並自然壽終；長照完全沿用原版的餵食、清潔、照護工作，並提供與醫療方針分流的「長照方針」。妥善照護的長者可能在床邊留下技能訓練器，隱藏的照護滿意度則決定殖民地面對其離世時的四階心情。
